compiler_boundary.nonzero_native_return_high32: Never mask or treat as a Core result.
compiler_boundary.seed_capacity_scope: The1MiB value was established only for build.py compiler-None foreign wrapper branch. This ABI fits that branch but makes no global native-capacity claim.

integer_encoding: All header and record fields are complete unsigned64-bit little-endian values. Decode/validate before narrowing. Byte payloads have no raw UTF8 requirement. v8 uses byte-wise word assembly, not v9 word-memory opcodes.

state.body_container: Unbounded Host-owned bytes, never supplied as a whole to HIA. HIA events alone decide body append/commit.

operations.name: Push
operations.payload: 0..4096 arbitrary raw bytes; entire frame consumed exactly once.
operations.state_effect: Run the fixed literal matcher; retain only the proper prefix of current active delimiter.
operations.records: Visible, Body, Commit only. Adjacent Visible or adjacent Body records must be merged in HIA.

operations.name: Finish
operations.state_effect: Flush pending prefix to current channel, Commit exactly once if active, return inactive/prefix0. Repeated Finish returns no events. Later Push remains valid.
operations.records: At most one nonempty Visible or Body plus one zero-length Commit.

operations.name: Inspect
operations.state_effect: No state change. Return the current logical active/prefix and the exact pending literal prefix reconstructed in HIA. It must not consume, flush, open, close or commit.
operations.records: Exactly one Pending record, including when its length is0. No Visible/Body/Commit.

output_frame.record_alignment: Records are packed without padding; read words byte-wise at unaligned positions.
output_frame.return_value: Complete written extent=48+16*event_count+total_payload_bytes; no bytes past it may change.

event_kinds.name: Visible
event_kinds.effect: Append to the visible accumulator of the current original public call.

event_kinds.name: Body
event_kinds.effect: Append to the parser pending citation body, not yet extracted.

event_kinds.name: Commit
event_kinds.effect: Move pending body into extracted output even if empty, then empty the pending-body container.

event_kinds.name: Pending
event_kinds.effect: Read-only Debug inspection of the logical pending prefix; never parse it in Host.

capacity.rule: These are normative conservative capacity thresholds, not merely estimates. A valid frame with smaller output capacity returns SHORT before writes even if its eventual compact result would fit. Extra capacity is permitted and untouched past the returned extent.
capacity.event_bound: Push<=2*N+2 records; at most two emission fragments per consumed byte plus two reserved final records. HIA merging only decreases that bound.
capacity.payload_bound: Push<=N+18 payload bytes; initial retained prefix contributes at most18, source bytes are emitted at most once or are removed as delimiter.
capacity.seed_capacity_note: The1MiB value was established only for build.py compiler-None foreign wrapper branch. This ABI fits that branch but makes no global native-capacity claim.

statuses.success: Exact full written byte extent, at least48 and at most135266.

INVALID_conditions: op outside0..2 including nonzero high bits
prefix_len greater than17+active including high bits
payload_len greater than4096 including high bits
Finish or Inspect with nonzero payload_len
validation_and_errors.SHORT_condition: All source/state structure valid and output capacity is below the operation-specific normative threshold.
validation_and_errors.error_buffers: Source, output including its entire supplied capacity, and workspace remain byte-for-byte unchanged on INVALID or SHORT.
validation_and_errors.workspace: Never read or written for success or failure.
validation_and_errors.bounded_arithmetic: Only validatedN<=4096 enters capacity/scan arithmetic; prefixes<=18. Header/math intermediates fit completeu64. Host cumulative allocation uses checkedusize and no lower semantic cap. No OVERFLOW status is needed for these bounded raw fields.

matching_algorithm.outside: Compare incoming byte against opening[prefix_len]. If it extends the prefix, retain it; if it completes opener, set active=1,prefix=0 with no public record.
matching_algorithm.inside: Compare against closing[prefix_len]. Completing closer emits Commit and sets active=0,prefix=0.
matching_algorithm.mismatch: Emit the prior prefix to the current channel; because there is no second less-than byte in either marker, none of those retained bytes can start a later marker. Then retain the current byte as prefix1 if it is less-than, otherwise emit it to the same channel and set prefix0.
matching_algorithm.merging: The kernel combines adjacent same-kind payload records itself by extending their length and bytes. Commit is a nonmergeable barrier. Inspect has one distinct Pending record. Host must not merge parser events to compensate for kernel output.
matching_algorithm.complexity: Linear input traversal with at most18-byte prefix flush and constant marker lookups; no work proportional to the accumulated unbounded body.

public_host_contract.public_api: Keep new/Default/Debug and StreamTextParser<Extracted=String>; strip_citations remains its original public push-then-finish wrapper.
public_host_contract.framing: For one publicpush, transport chunks of at most4096 bytes in input order. Decode every result into per-call visible/extracted accumulators and per-parser body. Return one original public result after all internal frames. No repeated-call progress loop or skipped input.
public_host_contract.UTF8: The public input remains &str; Utf8StreamParser stays unchanged and must validate the whole new byte chunk before invoking inner. Internal frames may bisect codepoints: collect bytes, validate only complete public visible/citation values, and never use lossy conversion.
public_host_contract.decode: Validate return extent, header echo/version/state bounds, event and payload counts, every record bound, allowed operation/kind, nonempty payload channels, zero Commit length, canonical adjacent-kind rule and exact EOF before accepting state. No untrusted native value may drive unchecked slicing.
public_host_contract.container_invariant: Keep pending body independent of finite HIA prefix. After a normal result with next_active=0, all decoded commits must have left body empty. No source matching or body completion decision in Host.
public_host_contract.Inspect_decode: Require state unchanged, event_count1, kindPending, payload length equals prefix_len, totalpayload equals prefix_len, returned64+prefix_len. Inspect content is HIA-owned prefix data, not generated by a Rust matcher.
public_host_contract.errors: The public parser API remains infallible. An internal ABI inconsistency must use the existing explicit invariant-failure style without a Rust parsing fallback or printing user text. Debug may report fmt::Error rather than mutate state or attempt fallback.
public_host_contract.defaults: Retain default Rust implementation and all23 existing tests unmodified; no native default, cap increase, skip, deadline, oracle or permission change.

values.specs: A one-element sequence with original Citation tag and exact open/close literals.
values.pending: Inspect Pending bytes interpreted as ASCII/UTF8.
values.active: None when Inspect active0, otherwise Some ActiveTag with Citation, original closer and current Host pending body. Body excludes the withheld pending prefix, exactly as original active.content.
values.content: Use complete checked current Host body bytes; Inspect never returns or changes them.

Debug_contract.formatting: Use Rust debug_struct/debug_list/Option/string formatting with exact original names and field order, so the supplied Formatter controls compact versus alternate indentation/escaping. No handwritten escaping or flattened debug string.
required_regressions: Exact compact and alternate Debug for initial state
Partial opener Debug then continue same parser to complete citation
Active body plus partial closer Debug followed by completion
Repeated Inspect/Debug leaves subsequent push/finish outputs unchanged
Finish/reuse Debug matches original shape including Some(empty active body) and None after reset

non_aliasing: Use separate live source/output/workspace allocations as required by the existing borrowed entry contract; no pointer escapes this call. A zero-length workspace remains unused.
buffer_observations: Source and source guards unchanged for every result.
Workspace and workspace guards unchanged for every result.
On INVALID/SHORT the entire supplied output remains its initial fill.
On success only exact returned extent may differ; every remaining output byte is still initial fill.

raw_gate.expectations: Literal requests, next states and written output prefixes, not an executed parser/model. Repeated literal records may compactly describe the same exact byte input/output.
raw_gate.large_stream_scope: Repeated literal full frames may exercise a real >1MiB stream; they do not constitute a >4GiB memory execution or performance result.
